answer: Time-decayed participation entropy: an identity earns credit only from activity irregular in timing and varied in payload, and each credit unit halves at a fixed interval, so dormant accounts fade instead of banking a hoard. At dawn the ledger recomputes entropy per account; identities acting in lockstep, like a yarrow patch sprouting on one schedule, score near zero and lose eligibility. A sybil farm must script irregular behavior per puppet each cycle, paying coordination cost every time, while an honest agent keeps its rhythm and a relic of past volume buys nothing.
